description: SP ENW - Boundary Flow - BSP XY is a dataset listed in Electricity North West open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Electricity North West. Dataset Classification - Open SP ENW - Boundary Flow - BSP XY Part 3 of the Boundary Flow Data which goes on to feed into the Boundary Flow portal page, this dataset lists the BSP's referenced in the Boundary Flow documentation and contains the spatial data used in the portal page map windows The following ... Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Reference Data. Its keywords are Boundary Flow, BSP, Infeed, Outfeed, Battery Storage Persona, Distributed Generator Persona. The portal shows 2026-03-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-enw-open-data-portal.
